# A smaller invoice for the same customer, asking for whatever credit they
# have. Imported while an earlier invoice sits unposted, the credit GnuCash
# finds is that invoice's orphaned settlement: it applies 40.00 of the 100.00
# and carves the remaining 60.00 into a new split.
#
# Rebuilding a payment's splits, GnuCash copies the source split's whole slot
# frame onto every split it makes — so the 60.00 remainder arrives carrying the
# first invoice's `orphaned_by_unpost` mark, describing a split it merely came
# from. Left on, the first invoice's rebuild would prefer that remainder, take
# the customer's real credit as its own settlement, and keep a cost basis for
# currency it no longer holds.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.

invoice "INV-USD-SMALL"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-01
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-01
		description: "Small job"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 40
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-01
		due: 2026-04-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-SMALL"
		accumulate: true
